Class AllureReportLaunch

java.lang.Object
com.shaft.tools.io.AllureReportLaunch
public final class AllureReportLaunch extends Object
Prepares an out-of-process rebuild of SHAFT.Report.generateAllureReport(Path). The public report method stays source-compatible and runs in the current JVM. A separate launcher must use this helper: a JDK whose major version is at least the SHAFT class-file version, a Maven classpath rebuild that uses -o only when shaft-engine is already in the local repository, a hard failure when com/shaft/driver/SHAFT.class is missing, and a Java @argfile so Windows can pass -cp without hitting the command-line length limit.

    • javaMajorRequiredBy

      public static int javaMajorRequiredBy(byte[] classBytes)
      Reads the Java major version required by a class-file header. SHAFT is compiled to major 69, which is Java 25.
      Parameters:
      classBytes - at least the first eight bytes of a class file
      Returns:
      the Java major version (classMajor - 44)

    • jdkMajor

      public static int jdkMajor(Path jdkHome)

    • resolveJdkHome

      public static Path resolveJdkHome(String javaHome, List<Path> fallbacks, int minimumMajor, AllureReportLaunch.JdkMajorProbe probe)
      Selects javaHome when its javac major is at least minimumMajor; otherwise the first fallback that qualifies.
      Parameters:
      javaHome - preferred JAVA_HOME, or blank
      fallbacks - extra JDK homes, such as a Temurin 25 directory
      minimumMajor - required major, normally engineJavaMajor()
      probe - how to read a JDK major; tests inject this and production uses jdkMajor(Path)
      Returns:
      the selected JDK home

    • writeClasspathArgFile

      public static Path writeClasspathArgFile(Path argFile, List<String> classpathEntries, String trailingArgument) throws IOException
      Writes a Java argument file whose first argument is -cp. Launch with javaCommand(Path, String...) so the classpath is not placed on the process command line.
      Parameters:
      argFile - destination, for example target/shaft-report.args
      classpathEntries - classpath entries; backslashes are written as / because Java argument files treat \ as an escape
      trailingArgument - program or source file that follows -cp, or blank
      Returns:
      argFile
      Throws:
      IOException - when the file cannot be written

    • javaCommand

      public static List<String> javaCommand(Path argFile, String... trailing)
      Builds the java command that launches the report from an argument file.
      Parameters:
      argFile - file produced by writeClasspathArgFile(Path, List, String)
      trailing - arguments that follow the argument file, such as the source file and results directory
      Returns:
      java @argfile ... with no inline classpath
